(2) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government
may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint, and different dates
may be appointed for different provisions of this Sanhita.
(3) Every person shall be liable to punishment under this Sanhita and
not otherwise for every act or omission contrary to the provisions thereof,
of which he shall be guilty within India.

according to the provisions of this Sanhita for any act committed beyond
India in the same manner as if such act had been committed within India.
(5) The provisions of this Sanhita shall also apply to any offence

(b) any person on any ship or aircraft registered in India
wherever it may be;

committing offence targeting a computer resource located in India.

committed outside India which, if committed in India, would be punishable
under this Sanhita.

and beyond India.
He can be tried and convicted of murder in any place in India in which
he may be found.

punishing mutiny and desertion of officers, soldiers, sailors or airmen in the
service of the Government of India or the provisions of any special or local

phase11.summary_answer: Yes, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 applies to Indian citizens committing offences outside India.
phase11.detailed_answer: According to Section 1(5)(a) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the provisions of this Act apply to any offence committed by any citizen of India in any place outside India. This means that an Indian citizen can be tried and convicted in India for acts committed abroad that would be punishable under this Act if committed within India.
